'''Project Dead Eye''' was developed around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] was sent to steal it from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] people.
